title: Hawkeye Thumb 4K: Simultaneous Stream+Record UNVERIFIED
context: Hawkeye Thumb 4K ($60, 16.5g) is Avatar's selected camera. Must serve dual role: CV feed + 4K recording with gyro data.
what_was_found: Hawkeye Thumb 4K is NOT explicitly listed in Gyroflow's camera_identifier.rs source code. Generic gyro data path exists but untested. Simultaneous UVC streaming while recording 4K to SD card is UNVERIFIED — the single biggest hardware uncertainty.
contingency: If dual-role fails: add ESP32-CAM ($10, 2g) for CV + dedicated BMI270 IMU ($3-5, <1g) for gyro data. Hawkeye handles 4K recording only.
action: Before purchase: find review showing UVC mode. Test gyro data quality on ground. Budget $10 for ESP32-CAM backup.
